scope: All twenty already published original Float32 65x65 windows and all 49 dyadic tensor grids, three equally shared-C0-fitted families, 2940 new models. The existing windows and previous results are known, not a holdout or independently surveyed ground truth. Before this full protocol, four foundation tests observed affine reproduction, exact full ruled identity, and improvement for Manchester-centre homogeneous 4x8 and full-grid minus P1. Two further metric tests checked Manchester 1x2,4x8,8x4,64x64 homogeneous and repeating mixed families against independent GL5 and affine zero errors. No all-site fitting results have yet been observed.
structure: Keep the complete original grid XY, shared corners, native record topology, geoframe and GPR4 byte cost. P1 uses the already frozen diagonal-hybrid-v1 p1-local cell families; hybrid uses its hybrid-local families. Pure ruled uses the prior hybrid-source-v1 ruled candidate. Never reselect orientations/types after fitting. This is shared coefficient optimization of fixed spaces, not joint topology optimization, adaptive paper triangulation or a globally optimal hybrid basis.
fitting: All three methods minimize source-relative whole-domain squared L2 with shared corner Z free. Exact local mass matrices and source-cell loads; Jacobi-preconditioned CG starts at original sampled corners, solves for delta, tolerance 1e-12, 4096 iterations, true relative correction residual <=1e-11. Native finite coefficients remain within the frozen 10000-unit cap. Full ruled source grid returns an exact identity. Gradients may jump across C0 boundaries; original nodes need not remain interpolated.
acceptance: Each saved candidate is measured using analytic bilinear residual masses and clipped GL3 quadrature. Accept only if E2 does not exceed its exact original saved candidate by more than 1e-9*max(1,old E2). On solver/capacity/monotonicity failure retain the failure reason, original model, and any complete attempted model; use the original as an explicit fallback. Do not retune the frozen solver, grids, sites or tolerance after full outcomes.
metrics: Full 4096 m2 source domain, E2 in m2, integral RMS=E2/64, continuous maximum error at original source-cell corners plus oblique diagonal quadratic extrema. Add guard 1e-9 + max(abs(source Z))*1e-12 m for target selection. Independent GL5 saved-function integration must agree within 1e-8*max(1,E2) and maximum within 1e-8 m. Independent numeric GL5 Galerkin residual norm must be <=max(5e-10*initial correction load norm,1e-10*max(1,full source load norm)); this separate bound accounts for independent quadrature roundoff, not a replacement for producer true-residual tolerance. Existing native binary roundtrip/highest-point/gradient/C0 queries are required before publishing. Development caught and fixed reversed plus-diagonal sides in the new independent Galerkin auditor before the full study; all seven foundation/metric tests now pass. No interval proof or RAM/GPU/runtime claim.
selection: For each method and each complete byte ceiling choose lowest saved E2, then bytes,nx,ny. For each continuous maximum-error target choose minimum bytes, then E2,nx,ny. Retain all 200 budget rows, 120 target rows, missing candidates, original unfitted controls, coefficient-fit E2 gains, and maximum-error increases. Budget-equal means same ceiling, not identical actual bytes. Native header, all XYZ, indices and orientation/type runs count.
controls: Equally fitted two-diagonal P1 is the primary comparison, original P1/ruled/hybrid remain separate before/after controls. Original full source P2 and Float32 implicit-XY raster remain stronger exact-function controls. This is an extension of paper-style L2 metrics on real source windows, not the paper author's reported data/software or ArcGIS software performance. No blanket superiority claim.
